approved: Parliamentary Workplace Support Service (Consequential Amendments and Transitional Provisions) Bill 2023
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would remove the Parliamentary Workplace Support Service's power to review workplace complaints after two years.
The review function would be temporary until the proposed Independent Parliamentary Standards Commission is set up.
The amendments would take effect two years after the PWSS starts operating.
Repeals the review function of the Parliamentary Workplace Support Service.
Introduces a sunset provision so the review function ends after two years.
Transfers the review role to the proposed Independent Parliamentary Standards Commission once established.
The Parliamentary Workplace Support Service and the proposed Independent Parliamentary Standards Commission.
Parliamentary Workplace Support Service (Consequential Amendments and Transitional Provisions) Act 2023
